release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.16

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder from 4.0.15 stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice.

Labels is part of LockStepPDF. The Labels button opens the label sheet builder from this same program. There is no separate Labels program in the zip. Theme and unit stay in the LockStepPDF settings.

A CSV, XLSX, or ODS file dropped in an automation hot folder runs variable data and uses the PDF stored in the recipe. Page setup in that recipe no longer makes Run once ask for a PDF or image. Excel 97 .xls is not read. Save that sheet as .xlsx, .ods, or .csv.

Crop, Color, Rotate, Resize, and Bleed open from page controls as the full form. Apply can cover the selection, this document, or the whole tree. The stack line names the edit. Booklet scales the facing pages to the selected sheet so they meet at the spine.
